title: Modes of transport
competency: Compare land, water and air transport on the basis of their use.

keywords.def: Transport by road or rail, including pipelines.
Train transport; carries large amounts of heavy goods over long distances.
Long-distance transport of a liquid or gas through pipes.
Moving goods and people by boat or ship over water.
Moving passengers and cargo by aircraft such as aeroplanes and helicopters.

ideas.name: Land transport: road, rail and pipelines

en.text: Modes of transport are land, water and air. Land transport is by road or rail. Road transport is the oldest and most common; it gives door-to-door service. Railways carry heavy bulk goods far, but are costly to build in mountains. The Addis Ababa–Djibouti railway is 784 km.

screens.title: Door to door

screens.after: Road transport gives door-to-door service. Trains and ships stop only at stations and ports.

screens.title: 2.3.3 Modes of transport
paras: Modes of transport are the ways goods or people move: by land, air or water.
Land transport is by rail or by road: bus, car, bicycle, railway.

screens.title: A. Road transport
paras: Road transport is the most common and oldest mode.
It includes animals like mules, donkeys and horses, and vehicles like trucks and buses.
It has two advantages: door-to-door service, and it uses public highways that need no expensive terminal.

screens.title: B. Railway transport
paras: Trains carry large amounts of goods, usually over long distances.
They carry heavy bulk products like iron ore, coal and petroleum.
Railways are expensive to build in mountainous countries like Ethiopia. Trains cannot climb steep hillsides.
The main route is the Addis Ababa–Djibouti railway, 784 km long.

screens.title: Addis Ababa light train
paras: It is the first light train in eastern Africa, launched on 20 September 2015.
It covers 31.6 km in two lines.
East–West: Ayat to Torhayloch, through Megenagna, Meskel Square, Legehar and Mexico.
North–South: Menilik Square to Kality, through Merkato, Lideta, Legehar, Meskel Square and Gotera.
It reduces traffic congestion and air pollution and increases mobility.
screens.note: Focus: pipelines carry liquids and gases. Cables (internet, energy) and space (satellites) are other modes.

screens.text: A mode of transport accomplished either by road or railway is called…
screens.why: Land transport is by rail or road.
screens.clue: Roads and rails are on land.

screens.text: Why are railways expensive to build in Ethiopia?
opts: Ethiopia is mountainous and trains cannot climb steep hills
screens.ans: Ethiopia is mountainous and trains cannot climb steep hills

screens.ask: The Addis Ababa–Djibouti railway covers ___ km.
A train averages 98 km per hour on the 784 km Addis Ababa–Djibouti line. How many hours does the trip take? ___
screens.clue: Divide the distance by the speed.

en.text: Water transport is the cheapest way to move bulky goods over long distances. It needs ports and canals, not roads. In Ethiopia boats use Lake Tana, Lake Abaya and the Baro River. Air transport is the latest and fastest, good for perishable goods, but the most expensive.

screens.title: Cheap and bulky
screens.ask: A company must send 5,000 tonnes of coffee to Europe as cheaply as possible. Which mode should it use?
screens.after: Water transport is the cheapest for bulky goods over long distances.

screens.title: 2. Water transport
paras: Water transport is the cheapest form of transport for bulky goods over long distances.
It uses ships. It needs ports and canals, not heavy construction like roads.
It is not well developed in many parts of Ethiopia.

screens.title: 3. Air transport
paras: Air transport is the latest and fastest mode of transport.
Planes carry only some types of cargo, because of size and shape limits.
Planes are the least dependable and most expensive form of transport.
It suits perishable products and electronic materials.

defs: Moving goods and people by boat or ship over water.

screens.text: Air transport is the latest and fastest form of transport.

items: Railway: costly to build in mountains

screens.clue: Is it good or bad for the user?

screens.text: Fresh roses from Ethiopia must reach Amsterdam by tomorrow. Which mode fits best?
screens.why: Air is fastest and suits perishable products like flowers.

screens.text: Which pairing of goods and mode is the WORST choice?

Ten tonnes of coal by aeroplane
screens.ans: Ten tonnes of coal by aeroplane
screens.why: Coal is heavy and bulky, and air is the most expensive with size limits. Rail or ship suits coal.
screens.clue: Which is heavy cargo on the most expensive mode?
